Castle, Jr., special American Ambassador to Japan, was the principal speaker today at a ceremony at Tokio Imperial University in which he presented on behalf of the American Government, copies of the earliest Japanese-Ameilean treaties. Japan’s copies of these trestles have been destroyed In various catastrophies. The treaties will be placed In the National Historical Library.
